outcome: Incidence of cardiac arrest in pregnancy
cohort: 66 pregnant women who experienced cardiac arrest in the UK
finding: Cardiac arrest during pregnancy in the UK is rare, but associated with a high mortality rate, with delayed PMCS being associated with increased maternal death.
mod_finding: PMCS was performed in 49 women, with a significantly shorter time from collapse to PMCS in women who survived (median 3 minutes) compared to those who died (median 12 minutes).
